title: studio: the CEL editor's as-you-type check is given no list fields, so it never flags == / != on a multi-value field that the save then refuses
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5krBqrrgxCYgjXmfbv

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · found by the seat's contract review of PR #36207 (Part of #36167), record 7072103543, finding S2. The PR named #36185 as its carrier, but #36185 has merged without these files, and #36169 is closed.

## What happens
After #36207, `validateExpression` refuses `==` / `!=` on a list-valued field when its schema hint carries the field types or `multiValueFields`. Studio's as-you-type CEL check (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/CelPredicateField.tsx:303` → `celAuthoring.ts:679-683`) gets neither: no `inspectors/**` mount supplies `multiValueFields`, and this path never passes `fieldTypes`. The editor flags nothing while the author types, and the save is then refused by the object draft check or the server.

## Done when
Each `CelPredicateField` mount in the metadata-admin inspectors passes the object's list fields (types and `multiple`), so the editor shows the `list-equality` refusal while typing. Pin one inspector mount on a `multiple: true` field, with a scalar control.

reach: Studio form (any CEL predicate field on an object with a list field), by code reading in the contract review; to be measured once by the claimant.
Business reason: authors see the error only on save, not while writing the condition.
Reader: a domain:ui lane (Studio metadata-admin).
Dedupe: `CelPredicateField multiValueFields` → 0 hits.
Grade: p2. The save already refuses, so nothing is stored wrong; this is the editor's early warning.
